note: Committed selection rules read by scripts/select_lambda.py and scripts/select_alpha.py (lane L-AM16-ALPHA; the selection contract in docs/lane_specs/part2.md). The lambda grid, band, seed, iterations and default candidate, and the alpha grid, default, default candidate and iterations must agree with configs/distill.py; src/training/sweep_select.py refuses a disagreement. AM-19 (lane K2): the decision dates of both schedules, the launch order, the date instant, the stopped-early constants and the alpha date rule must equal sweep_select.py's constants, and the values the rule depends on (stage, seed, tie, boundary, default, band kind, value or floor, band file, winner_is) its rule pins.

lambda_logit.value: best_val_miou_all_class: the run's best-checkpoint VAL all-class mIoU (strict >, earliest tie, as E1)
lambda_logit.shortfall: AM-19 item 2: before the end of the lambda decision date the selection waits for every candidate; after it a non-default candidate that has neither finished nor diverged is cut at the decision date, and the selection runs among the finished candidates against a committed decision record whose statuses the code derives again (no selection without it); the default candidate is never cut and is waited for; a diverged non-default candidate is not a shortfall: its directory is supplied and it is excluded (AM-7a)

alpha_cwd.value: best_val_miou_all_class: the run's best-checkpoint VAL all-class mIoU

band.rule: band = max(floor, sqrt(2) * s); s = sample SD (n = 3) of E1's best VAL all-class mIoU over seeds 42, 43, 44

alpha_cwd.shortfall: AM-19 item 2: as for lambda, with the alpha decision date the later of its calendar date and the third day after the Asia/Manila day on which the commit that added the lambda selection file reached the remote; if no non-default candidate was launched before the end of that date the sweep is cut: alpha = 50 and no selection file (AM-16 item 2; AM-19 item 2(g)), stated by the committed decision record; a diverged non-default candidate is not a shortfall: its directory is supplied and it is excluded (AM-7a)
